narr: An axis of heavy rain set up along and south of US 24, with flash flooding reported in Fort Wayne along SR-1 and I 469. Isolated amounts of 3-6 of rain were reported, with reports of 1-3 more widespread. Several rivers went into action stage during the event.
ev: Emergency management and law enforcement officials reported high, flowing water over several roads along the south side of Fort Wayne east into Monroeville as anywhere from five to almost seven inches of rain fell. State Route 1 from Interstate 469 south to Hamilton Road was closed due to water covering the road. Trier ditch overflowed over Tillman Road between Hessen Cassel and Adams Center Roads. Several cars were stranded in parking lots with one in a ditch in Monroeville due to the high water.
